subject: MAP Kickoff: AWS channel launch for NimbusCloud — roles & 8-week timeline
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbuscloud.com>, Chris Park <chris.park@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@aws-partners.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: AWS channel launch for NimbusCloud — roles & 8-week timeline

Hi Elena / Chris —

Thanks for agreeing to kick off a mutual action plan for your AWS Marketplace launch. I’m Priya (Partner GTM at Redwood Inference); I’ll be the program lead from our side and primary day-to-day point of contact for the MAP.

Quick intro to attendees:
- Daniel (AWS PM) — partner ops and listing guidance
- Ben (Integration Engineering) — build/QA and runtime acceptance
- Vanessa (Marketplace Ops) — listing, pricing, and compliance coordination
- Alex (Solutions) — technical validation and performance artifacts

High-level objective: get NimbusCloud listed as a Redwood-verified offering in the AWS Marketplace with a staged launch (private listing -> public canary -> general availability) in ~8 weeks from today. Goal metrics: first production-ready listing, validated performance profile (latency p95), and pricing tile in marketplace.

I attached a starter MAP (NimbusCloud_MAP_v0.9.xlsx) and an AWS listing checklist (aws-listing-checklist.pdf). Please review and confirm the following by EOD Tuesday:
1) Primary contacts for legal/procurement at NimbusCloud for contract and pricing discussions
2) Technical owner for the embed/test harness and availability windows for runbook validation (Ben will need 3 full test days)
3) Any regulatory constraints we should factor into the timeline (data residency, encryption/SLA exceptions)

Proposed milestone cadence (we can adapt after your inputs):
- Week 1 (this week): finalize MAP owners, confirm artifacts needed
- Week 2: submit listing draft to AWS and start security questionnaire
- Week 4: run joint performance validation (internal staging)
- Week 6: private listing / canary to 10%
- Week 8: public launch + enable billing tile

If this looks reasonable, Elena — can you confirm legal and procurement contacts? Also Daniel, can you confirm an AWS ops lead who’ll own the listing submission and resolve catalogue errors?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Attachments: NimbusCloud_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (spreadsheet, MAP with milestones); aws-listing-checklist.pdf (PDF, step-by-step listing guide)

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com | +1 (415) 555-0193
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@aws-partners.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodai.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbuscloud.com>, Chris Park <chris.park@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodai.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: AWS channel launch for NimbusCloud — roles & 8-week timeline

Thanks Priya — happy to support.

Elena / Chris: assigning AWS ops lead: I’ve looped in Mari Torres (mari.torres@amazon.com) who will be the listing owner on the AWS side and will help triage any schema or catalog errors. She’s copied below.

Quick notes from AWS ops lens:
- Please ensure the product bundle (AMI/Container/Bring-your-own-license) is finalized before Week 2; we often see delays from changes to the product file.
- Provide signed Letter of Intent (LOI) or commercial contact if you want to enable the billing tile during canary.
- Seek clarification on data residency now if encrypted snapshots or cross-region buckets will be required — call this out in the MAP.

Happy to jump on a 30-min sync early next week to walk through the checklist.

Best,
Daniel

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks — confirming points on our side:
- Legal / Procurement: Elena Torres (elena.torres@nimbuscloud.com) will own redlines and PO terms; CC for procurement is procurement@nimbuscloud.com.
- Technical owner: I (chris.park@nimbuscloud.com) will lead integration and coordinate with Ben.
- Constraints: we have a pending internal SOC2 gap in backup encryption that may require a short exception window; I’ll include the mitigation notes in the MAP.

A couple of asks for Redwood before Week 2:
- Ben, can you share the test harness endpoints and expected sample payloads? We want to schedule compatibility testing (3x half-days) the week of Oct 11.
- Vanessa, please confirm whether Redwood will provide the performance artifact template (p95/p99 sample) or if we should put one together.

We’re available for a 30-min sync Tue 10/5 at 10:00 PT — propose calendar invite to align owners.

Thanks,
Chris Park
Head of Integrations | NimbusCloud

Thanks all — confirmed for Tue 10/5 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).

Follow-ups from my side:
- I’ll add the GA and canary dates to the MAP based on our proposed milestone cadence and lock pricing windows for the canary by Oct 19.
- Legal: Priya — to speed approvals, I’ll surface a standard listing addendum template that Nimbus can sign; Elena, I’ll send that after the call.
- Ben: attaching the test harness quick-start snippet (see attachment stub: redwood-harness-sample.txt) and the performance artifact template (perf-template.csv). Please confirm if the sample payloads are sufficient.

Attachments: redwood-harness-sample.txt (txt, sample test harness endpoints); perf-template.csv (CSV, p50/p95/p99 & token-rate columns)

If anyone sees major blockers after the sync, flag me and we’ll route to Daniel for expedited ops help.

-Vanessa
